bio: Malmaison Glasgow is a boutique hotel located just off Blythswood Square, between Glasgow Central train station and popular Sauchiehall Street.  Formerly a Greek Orthodox Church, the building has been transformed into a stylish, modern hotel, decorated with pop art and graffiti frescoes.  Malmaison have re-imagined the classic Afternoon Tea menu. Savouries include a beef slider on brioche bun, Cumberland sausage & apple roll and prawn cocktail. Sweet treats include Calamansi citrus meringue tart, dark chocolate & salted caramel tart and raspberry ripple & white chocolate sundae.  Special dietary requirements are catered for, with alternative menus for vegetarians/vegans and for those with gluten and nut allergies. Pre-booking is required. Please specify dietary needs using the 'Special Request' field.  All Afternoon Tea menus are served with a choice of teas and infusions, including English breakfast, Earl Grey and Green tea with jasmine.  Afternoon Tea is served Saturday and Sunday from 12pm to 4pm and costs £29.50 per person.
